description: This file defines an interface 'ConfigurationInterface' related to client-side monitoring configuration options within the AWS SDK for PHP. It specifies method signatures for accessing configuration parameters such as 'client_id', 'enabled', 'host', and 'port'.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: Interface that provides access to client-side monitoring configuration options such as 'client_id', 'enabled', 'host', and 'port'.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether or not client-side monitoring is enabled.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the Client ID, if available.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
